title: What the January pricing change means for your bill
prompt: An FAQ for our customers about the pricing change taking effect next quarter.
note: Customer-facing, so a serif title under a product kicker and every question as its own card with a short answer and a what-to-do line, because the reader is a billing contact who will forward one card, not the page. The three hardest questions sit first in a tinted band across the full width, ahead of the jump list's other groups, and the remaining questions run as two-column cards with the cheerful answers kept as short as the hard ones so the page does not read as spin.
